_comment: firecracker-containerd runtime defaults. Installed to /etc/containerd/firecracker-runtime.json and located by the daemon via FIRECRACKER_CONTAINERD_RUNTIME_CONFIG_PATH. The coordinator overrides networking + machine size per VM through CreateVM; kernel, boot args and the VM agent rootfs come from here.
kernel_args: console=ttyS0 noapic reboot=k panic=1 pci=off nomodules ro systemd.unified_cgroup_hierarchy=0 systemd.journald.forward_to_console systemd.unit=firecracker.target init=/sbin/overlay-init
